item.title: Can Space Be Disrupted Like the Strait of Hormuz?
item.description: Like the Strait of Hormuz, space is a chokepoint that can be disrupted. That disruption can be achieved and sustained without having domain superiority, and that, once disrupted, it is hard to return things back to the old normal.

item.title: The European Union in the New Trade Disorder
item.description: As protectionism rises and the WTO falters, global trade is being rewired, not collapsing. New hubs centered on the European Union and the CPTPP are reshaping flows, rules, and alliances—and Europe is positioning itself as a leader in a more fragmented but still rules-based system.

item.title: 10 Charts to Explain Global Immunization Policy—Where the United States Stands
item.description: Global efforts to prevent disease outbreaks through immunizations play a role in domestic health security, but shifts in U.S. policy and engagement could threaten preparedness.

item.title: Strategic Landpower Dialogue: A Conversation with Major General Lars S. Lervik
item.description: Major General Lars S. Lervik, Chief of the Norwegian Army, joined CSIS to discuss Norwegian defense priorities, lessons learned from the war in Ukraine, Arctic operations, and more.

item.title: The War Against Time
item.description: This edition of the Economic Security and Technology Newsletter covers The War Against Time.

item.title: Trade or Aid
item.description: This week, Bill Reinsch assesses the Trump administration's “trade over aid" agenda at the United Nations, arguing that current U.S. trade policy does not encourage development in other countries.

item.title: How is the Iran War Impacting China's Economy
item.description: This report analyzes the most important economic impacts of the Iran war on China and shows that while China is better positioned than others, the conflict threatens China’s economy in key ways.

item.title: Expanding Access to Immunizations in the Americas | The CommonHealth Live!
item.description: Experts discuss the state of immunization programs in the Americas, what works to expand access to new vaccines, and the important roles played by schools, civil society organizations, and community groups in building and sustaining momentum for immunization programs.

item.description: This edition of Trendlines covers April 2026.

item.title: How Open-Source, Real-Time Data Can Defeat China at the Edge of Its Influence
item.description: Over the last year, CSIS hosted a high-level discussion series called “25 Gamechangers for 2025.” This piece highlights key insights from the talented cadre of thought leaders tasked with adapting U.S. strategy to a new era of strategic competition with China.
